verdict.rationale: Yubico documents that FIDO2 operations require user presence, meaning a physical touch, for cryptographic operations. A community user confirms the value of touch-to-sign: it cannot be triggered remotely. Yubico also ships SDKs such as python-fido2 and desktop/mobile libraries that could wire this touch into custom approval flows. Nothing in the pack shows a ready-made way to gate agent-initiated or automated actions, so each integrator must build that themselves. Missing for 10: documented agent/automation approval workflows, any first-party integration with AI agent tooling (no MCP or llms.txt), and hands-on evidence of touch-gating used for agent actions.
